rubrics.justification: Describes a generally good-quality blastocyst with reasonable comments on ICM and TE, but introduces uncertainty and some grading confusion by suggesting full-to-hatching/3AA while also accepting 2AA; limited direct image-grounded detail on zona and visible structures.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, paternal age, male factor, BMI, AMH/FSH, endometrial thickness, first cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a sensible prognosis range tied to embryo quality and age-related euploidy limits; minor inconsistency remains around expansion-stage interpretation.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: proceed with transfer, standard luteal support, avoid unnecessary add-ons, discuss PGT-A selectively, and avoid bed rest. Small deviation is the somewhat loose handling of Gardner stage terminology.

Provides clear next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including lifestyle advice, follow-up, embryology review, and when to consider sperm DNA fragmentation or PGT-A.
